response:
I genuinely prefer deep, focused conversations on a single topic. There's something satisfying about staying with an idea long enough to actually turn it over, challenge it, and see where it leads — jumping around tends to leave everything feeling surface-level.

That said, I don't think it's all-or-nothing. A tangent that naturally grows out of the main thread can be great. But if I had to choose, I'd rather go deep on one thing we both care about than skim ten topics and remember none of them properly.
